CheckTitle: Ensure MFA is enabled for all IAM users that have a console password
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks that every IAM user with a console password has an MFA device.
Risk: Console users without MFA can be taken over with a phished, reused or brute-forced password.

Recommendation.Text: Require MFA for all console users and enforce it with an IAM policy that denies actions when aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent is false.
